title: [AUTH-TASK-11] Token Refresh & Rotation Endpoint
objective: Implement refresh token rotation endpoint to renew access tokens while invalidating used refresh tokens.
specs:
- Endpoint: POST /api/v1/auth/refresh
- Input: TokenRefreshRequest (refresh_token: str)
- Response: HTTP 200 OK with new TokenResponse (access_token, refresh_token)
- Business Rules:
  * Decode refresh token and find by token_hash in db_auth
  * Check that token is not expired and is_revoked == False
  * Strict Rotation: Mark old token is_revoked = True, revoked_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  * Issue and store new refresh token and new access token
- Target Files: src/routers/auth.py, src/services/auth_service.py
deliverables:
- [ ] POST /api/v1/auth/refresh route

title: [AUTH-TASK-12] Session Revocation & Logout Endpoint
objective: Implement explicit logout endpoint revoking active sessions and invalidating refresh tokens.
specs:
- Endpoint: POST /api/v1/auth/logout
- Input: LogoutRequest (refresh_token: str) or Authorization header
- Response: HTTP 200 OK with LogoutResponse (message: 'Successfully logged out')
- Business Rules:
  * Extract session jti from token
